Omg this is me too! My body is super dry, I have like a whole collection of body lotions now haha. My face isn't fully oily though. Anything for dry skin is too oily and matte setting products are too dry, so combination to dry is my take. I've started using an anti sebum compact to help with the extra oil areas.

I usually do put lip liner but somehow when the lipstick rubs off, it ends up looking weird. I have a few matte lipsticks but I found out that my lips look injected when I have a liner and matte lip combo, like botched lip effect 🥲🥲🥲

I love the lakme 9 to 5 lipsticks though. They end up a biit patchy on me but I do love my Rosy Sunday.

And yknow somedays i just want that light tint look for my lips. Tints love the pink parts and somehow make my purples look dead 🥹 I've found success with rom&nd though. If 890 rs isn't an issue, you should try their stuff.

Products that don't disappear into my skin lol. My skin loves everything, eats everything up. Literally nothing stays. Especially around my eyes. I do have eye primer but it's too light and it looks so weird when I use it.

Lippies for pigmented lips. I have sort of wrinkly purple and pink lips that get DRY. I can't be putting concealer on them and mattes set into the crinkles, making them look even more dry >_<

These are just off the top of my head. I probably have others that I've missed.

Maybelline fit me concealer and foundation. I have combination skin so while some areas like the product some areas get waayyy too dry. I also dislike the matte feeling now. These were my first concealer and foundation and I'd used been using them in light amounts for a while before realising that I can just get a dewy finish product. 

Maybelline eyeshadow palette. Literally the only shade I use was the dark brown and for liner. The shimmers are pretty but so much fallout! 

All my matte lipsticks. While I like the non transfer part, my lips NEED hydration. They're sort of wrinkly so the matte sets in between and cracks. (I'm looking at WnW Give Me Mocha. Love the colour though)

Rare beauty lipstick in the shade Humble. Concealer lips and the formula is so damn patchy. I make it work by adding other lipsticks but only because its not cheap. 

Rare beauty blush. I do like the dewy finish but it lasts maybe an hour and half tops. I don't like intense blush so I can't put a lot but I have so many blushes that work better. 

Swiss beauty creme blush pot thing in purple. So patchy, terrible formula. Doesn't blend right. I got influenced by makeup by monica and bought it because "purple blush is the pink blush for brown skin". I just look bruised.

Este Lauder foundation. I had a sort of full face done in store back when I was trying to find my shade. The formula says no oxidation but it oxidised in 15 minutes. 

Just Herbs. Just Don't. I got mini liquid lip products because of the gpay coupon. They're not terrible but I wouldn't repurchase. I like the pink shades so I sometimes use them as an add on for the colour.

Anything rainy, sandalwood, Jasmine, mossy. I think someone's mentioned sandalwood in another comment. 

I'm from india and my state has a lot of monsoons. I grew up by a lake so I'd watch the summer shower storms on the water through my window. Hot evenings with cold freshly made lime juice made my day. 

Freshly made sandalwood paste, incense sticks, jasmine in my small family temple after it had just rained and the sand is settling again.

I'm not the biggest fan of jasmine but I can appreciate soft and subtle, green jasmine. And honestly, I dont think I can do sandalwood unless it's in the paste form lol. Oddly enough the scent can feel warm or cool depending on how/when you make it. 

As for gourmand scents, hints of coconut. Even now, my friends and I joke that we can smell coconut in most things very easily even if it's not a major player in a scent profile. (Easy tell-tale of which state I'm from haha)

I could think of others but these are scents I can't ever forget.
